final: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(CAST(rental_rate AS REAL) / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS per_rating_average, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(per_rating_average) AS overall_average FROM rating_averages) SELECT r.rating, r.per_rating_average, r.film_count, r.per_rating_average / o.overall_average AS relative_average FROM rating_averages AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_average IS NOT NULL
